subtasks.title: Implement rebuild executor: upstream fetch and temp branch setup
details: Implement RebuildExecutor.Execute(ctx, payload RebuildJobPayload) (*RebuildResult, error)
Step 1: Resolve upstream credentials via resolveUpstreamAuth (from spec 15) with fallback to origin credentials
Step 2: Fetch from upstream remote using go-git FetchContext with resolved auth
Step 3: Resolve upstream tracking branch HEAD (workspace.branch field, defaulting to remote default branch)
Step 4: Create temporary branch at upstream HEAD using GitRunner.CreateBranch
Collect patches: query patches table for status IN ('active','conflict') ORDER BY position ASC

subtasks.title: Implement rebase strategy: per-patch cherry-pick loop
details: For each patch in position order: call GitRunner.LogCommits(upstreamHead, patchBranch) to get unique commits
If patch branch does not exist: append skipped result, continue (do not halt)
Cherry-pick each commit in reverse-log order onto temp branch via GitRunner.CherryPick
On success: advance temp branch pointer, append success result with new_head_sha
On CherryPickConflictError: check rerere resolution (see REQ-3 implementation), handle conflict or continue

subtasks.title: Implement rebuild success path: ref update and merged_upstream cleanup
details: After all patches applied: force-update integration branch ref to temp branch HEAD via GitRunner.ForceUpdateRef
Update workspace.head_sha in DB to new integration HEAD SHA
Delete temp branch via GitRunner.DeleteBranch
Auto-cleanup: DELETE FROM patches WHERE workspace_id=? AND status='merged_upstream'
Compact remaining positions: UPDATE patches SET position=row_number ORDER BY position
Populate RebuildResult: upstream_head_sha, integration_head_sha, strategy, patches_applied, patches_skipped, patches_removed, patch_results

task_groups.title: Implement Rebuild Algorithm: Merge Strategy and Conflict Fail-Fast

subtasks.title: Implement merge strategy: per-patch --no-ff merge loop
details: When payload.Strategy == 'merge': for each patch call GitRunner.MergeNoFF(tempBranch, patchBranch)
On success: advance temp branch pointer, append success result with new_head_sha
On MergeNoFFConflictError: invoke rerere resolution check (shared with rebase path)
If patch branch does not exist: append skipped result, continue
Ensure REBUILD_STRATEGY defaults to 'rebase' when workspace variable is empty or unset

subtasks.title: Implement conflict fail-fast: abort, DB update, temp branch cleanup
details: On unresolved conflict: abort cherry-pick or merge via GitRunner.AbortCherryPick / GitRunner.AbortMerge
UPDATE patches SET status='conflict', conflict_files=<json array> WHERE id=<patch_id>
Delete temp branch via GitRunner.DeleteBranch
Do NOT update integration branch ref
Return RebuildResult with integration_head_sha=null, patch_results showing conflicting patch with status='conflict' and conflict_files populated

subtasks.title: Implement rerere resolution check helper
details: Implement checkRerereResolved(ctx, repoPath string) (bool, []string, error)
Run GitRunner command: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U to list unresolved conflict files
If output is empty: return true (all resolved), nil files
If output is non-empty: return false, list of unresolved file paths
This helper is called after every CherryPickConflictError and MergeNoFFConflictError
If rerere resolved all: continue cherry-pick/merge (git cherry-pick --continue or git merge --continue)

subtasks.title: Implement GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rerere endpoint
details: Read .git/rr-cache/ directory for the workspace clone path
For each subdirectory: read preimage or postimage file to extract the conflicted path
Derive recorded_at from file modification time (os.Stat); set null if unavailable
Return JSON: {resolutions: [{path: string, recorded_at: string|null}]}
Require workspaces:read permission (existing scope)

subtasks.title: Implement DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rerere/*pathspec endpoint
details: Register Echo route with wildcard: DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rerere/*pathspec
Extract pathspec from Echo wildcard parameter (handles slashes in file paths)
Check if pathspec has a recorded resolution in rr-cache; return 404 if not found
Execute GitRunner command: git rerere forget <pathspec>
Return 204 on success
Require workspaces:read permission (existing scope)

subtasks.title: Implement carry-patch sync extension: upstream fetch and merge detection
details: Extend existing sync handler (spec 13) with carry-patch branch: detect workspace.mode == 'carry_patch'
Resolve upstream credentials via resolveUpstreamAuth; fetch from 'upstream' remote
Compare new upstream HEAD against stored upstream_head_sha
Advance upstream tracking ref using same fast-forward logic as standard sync
For each active patch: call GitRunner.IsAncestor(patchBranchHead, newUpstreamHead)
Transition detected patches to merged_upstream status; collect branch names for response

subtasks.title: Implement auto-rebuild trigger after carry-patch sync
details: After sync completes: check if upstream ref advanced OR any patches transitioned to merged_upstream
Read AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC workspace variable; default to true if unset
If true: enqueue rebuild job via job queue; set rebuild_triggered=true in sync response
If enqueue returns duplicate key error: set rebuild_triggered=false (silently ignore)
If AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC=false: set rebuild_triggered=false, do not enqueue
Extend sync response JSON with patches_merged and rebuild_triggered fields (omit for standard workspaces)
